qualification.package: Clean public wheel/sdist; 12 focused face-encoder/version CPU checks. Both unprivileged image imports, matching visible source and default pipeline CLI verified. Images reuse immutable 0.9.0 dependencies and install the selected wheel offline. No model weights are bundled.
qualification.engine: Three application integration scenes on a 48 GiB RTX 4090 showed lower complete face-pass latency with whole-crop spatial encoding. The explicit public encoder profile reproduced all 120 final RGB frames of one qualified prototype case. Package-version and installation-documentation changes after the algorithm revision change no inference implementation. Original two-step repaint and explicit 44 sparse / 6 dense attention were retained.
qualification.limits: Only explicit 512-square, 124-frame face encoding is newly supported. Removing spatial tiles changes context, normalization and some output details; this is not equivalence to the tiled encoder. Encoder-only peak allocation reached 16.19 GiB; full-pipeline capacity is separate. Standard 24 GiB RTX 4090, other devices, cuts, identity and wider timelines are not newly qualified. Public images have CPU/dependency/CLI checks, not a new GPU image matrix. Application restoration models and deployment remain separate. Defaults are unchanged.
